proposed_research_claim: Local recovery verifier blindness under snapshot corruption (H1)
limitations_and_alternative_explanations: Exercised strictly via simulated memory pointer corruption; production binary does not expose snapshot state.

proposed_research_claim: Native NTT monitor achieves genuine recovery under transient butterfly faults (F4)
limitations_and_alternative_explanations: Tested on intermediate t bit flips; multi-layer burst faults not evaluated.

proposed_research_claim: Native NTT monitor enforces safe fail-stop under persistent faults (F5A, F5B)
limitations_and_alternative_explanations: Evaluated via software hook persistence; does not model analog silicon latch-up.

proposed_research_claim: Decapsulation implicit rejection conforms exactly to FIPS 203 (K_bar = J(z || c))
limitations_and_alternative_explanations: Evaluated on 100 controlled mutations; verified bit-for-bit against clean-room Keccak.

proposed_research_claim: Absence of Silent Data Corruption (H2 = 0.0%) across tested scenarios
limitations_and_alternative_explanations: Bounded by empirical sample size (95% CI: [0.0%, 0.28%]); does not prove mathematical impossibility under arbitrary physical attacks.

proposed_research_claim: Dual-rail verification prevents single-locus predicate bypass in decapsulation
limitations_and_alternative_explanations: Susceptible to simultaneous double-faults collapsing both rails to zero.

proposed_research_claim: The implementation is certified constant-time across decapsulation branches
limitations_and_alternative_explanations: No cycle-accurate timing or dudect leakage tests executed; compiler optimizations can break constant-time source.

proposed_research_claim: The ML-KEM native implementation possesses physical fault resilience
limitations_and_alternative_explanations: Software hooks cannot model physical silicon fault dynamics.

proposed_research_claim: ML-KEM-768 possesses general or unconditional fault tolerance
limitations_and_alternative_explanations: Unconditional fault tolerance is impossible against targeted physical comparison skips.
